actions.label: Restart server
actions.description: Reload the dev.budgetr.server + caddy LaunchAgents. Builds only if .next is missing.

actions.label: Rebuild & restart server
actions.description: Force a production build of web/, then reload both LaunchAgents.
actions.confirm: Rebuilds web/ and reloads the LaunchAgents. budgetr.localhost is down for the duration of the build.

actions.label: Release
actions.description: Merge a branch into main, bump web/package.json, tag, and push. The tag push triggers the signed + notarized DMG workflow.
actions.confirm: Merges into main, creates a tag, and pushes both — which starts the public GitHub release. Use Dry run first if unsure.
